endorsements.quote: Equally important is the establishment of AI accountability guidelines, clarifying roles and responsibilities for data quality, algorithmic decisions, and potential harms.

Additional risk management considerations include providing regulatory sandboxes to allow for the safe testing and iteration of AI-powered healthcare applications and establishing policies to distribute accountability for software and AI risk.
This requires mechanisms for bias detection, mitigation, and ongoing monitoring.

unlisted_practices: Develop a national strategy for deploying AI in healthcare.
Invest in broadband connectivity, EHR adoption, data standards, and interoperability as foundations for healthcare AI.
Implement data quality management, including cleaning, filtering, and reformatting of EHR data, before AI model development.
Provide incentives and disincentives to drive nationwide interoperability between healthcare platforms.
Invest in tailored point-of-care AI products that function without continuous internet access for low-resource settings.
Build a national AI education and upskilling workforce pipeline, including integrating AI education into medical and nursing programs.
Foster international collaboration to create a healthcare AI framework tailored to the local context.
Establish AI Centers of Excellence to provide technical assistance, training, feasibility studies, and performance monitoring of AI healthcare solutions.
Adopt a risk-based approach to regulating healthcare AI drawing on standards such as ISO/IEC 42001 and the NIST AI RMF.
Develop clear national guidelines on transparency and explainability requirements for different healthcare applications.
Develop monitoring and evaluation systems to assess the impact of AI interventions.
Keep a human in the loop and encourage reflection on AI outputs to address user over-reliance.
Enact robust privacy and security measures and comply with data protection regulations.
Consider opportunity costs and align AI investments with immediate healthcare priorities.
